response.rationale: Both answers are accurate for the stated varieties and sense. Indonesian teman sekelas and Malaysian rakan sekelas both mean a student in the same class. The contrast is a usage-preference distinction, not a false-friend contrast; the relation label is acceptable if not interpreted as exclusive.
